summary: The settings framework is built on a two-level caching architecture, a strict validate_assignment invariant, a structural/runtime parameter split, dynamic Pydantic field installation for connection profiles, and a two-pass secrets resolution pipeline. Understanding these layers gives you full visibility into how configuration flows from files and environment variables through to cached, validated settings instances.

concepts.name: Two-level caching architecture
concepts.description: An lru_cache on _get_settings() provides fast, process-global memoization keyed by structural parameters. SettingsManager maintains a secondary dictionary store for named lookups. apply_runtime_overrides() returns a model_copy(), ensuring the cached base instance is never mutated.

concepts.name: SettingsParameters structural/runtime split
concepts.description: Custom __hash__ and __eq__ on SettingsParameters include only structural fields (files, env prefix), making them suitable as cache keys. Runtime parameters (per-call kwargs) are applied after cache lookup via apply_runtime_overrides(). The merge() method uses field-specific strategies: union for file lists, last-wins for scalars, and deep-merge for dictionaries.

concepts.name: validate_assignment=True and object.__setattr__ invariant
concepts.description: All attribute assignment triggers Pydantic validation, including SecretStr wrapping, enum coercion, and AfterValidator hooks. Internal metadata fields (SETTINGS_SOURCE_*) use object.__setattr__ to bypass revalidation and avoid polluting model_fields_set. This pattern is documented in the setattr-bypass-fix design spec.

concepts.name: DescriptorProfile dynamic field installation
concepts.description: __pydantic_init_subclass__ fires at class creation time and installs fields from the profile descriptor into model_fields and __annotations__. A model_rebuild(force=True) call finalises the updated schema. The auth discriminated union is assembled dynamically from the descriptor's auth_modes list.

concepts.name: Secrets resolution pipeline
concepts.description: Resolution runs in two passes during __init__: first on raw kwargs via resolve_references_in_dict before super().__init__, then on loaded config fields via resolve_references_in_model_tree after construction. Nested BaseModel fields are rebuilt as fresh instances to respect the frozen=True constraint.

concepts.name: Config file dispatch pipeline
concepts.description: Files are separated by extension into categorised groups (env, YAML, TOML, JSON). The appropriate file path is set on model_config before calling super().__init__(). settings_customise_sources() returns the source priority tuple that Pydantic uses to layer values.

concepts.name: Concurrency and evolution considerations
concepts.description: model_config mutation before super().__init__ operates at the class level; concurrent first-construction of different file sets on the same class should be serialised. The SettingsManager dictionary is similarly designed for single-threaded first-creation. Dynamic field installation via model_rebuild() should be verified after Pydantic version upgrades.
